metadata.scope: Five analytical roles; no external AI model, AGI, market feed or trade execution.
assumptions: Known generator parameters are supplied to the regime filter; no empirical fitting.
Three Gaussian experts are fixed; weights update without forgetting or parameter learning.
Scenario horizon is one hypothetical observation; shocks have no occurrence probabilities.
Simple portfolio returns exclude fees, market impact, leverage and execution.
Held-out draws share the specified model; they do not validate real-market behaviour.

correlation_stress.purpose: Joint-dependence shock with a loss in the normally low-volatility fourth asset.

model.random_streams: NumPy SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3): history, optimisation scenarios, held-out scenarios.

data.state_label_meaning: Known simulation labels, displayed for diagnosis only and never supplied as filter observations.

assumptions: Equal probability for rows within each scenario set.
Worst-case CVaR across supplied scenario sets, without probabilities between sets.
Long-only fully invested research target; no fees, execution, financing or liquidity model.
Risk is conditional on supplied scenarios and does not bound unseen market losses.

policy.meaning: Illustrative thresholds, not calibrated suitability or statistical sufficiency rules.

governance.authority: research review only; no order or execution path
governance.sweep_meaning: Only the tail-risk threshold changes; this does not replace the other gates.
governance.risk_evidence: Maximum of fitted and separately drawn held-out worst-scenario CVaR.

trace.method: Pre-observation predictions, likelihood update and variance decomposition
Joint conditional draws plus imposed shocks; independent validation stream
Minimise worst supplied scenario CVaR with long-only weight cap
Held-out scenario challenge, uncertainty diagnostic and non-overridable research gates

diagnostics.disagreement_meaning: Between fixed expert means only; shared model error and parameter uncertainty are absent.
